localChanges: A new Enhanced rule, off to start with, takes each civilization through eight ages as it learns, from the Ancient Age to the Space Age. You're told when yours enters a new one, your age shows in the top bar, and the Intelligence report shows the age of each civilization you have an embassy with (#1076).

log: feat: ages a civilization moves through as it learns (civ-clone/web-renderer#1076)
fix: judge each advance by what was known up to it, and hold joining players quiet (civ-clone/web-renderer#1076)
docs: why the example registers reachAge at Low

Each civilization moves through eight ages, one per research tier, entering one with the first advance it gains of that tier; player:age-reached tells of it. Starting advances, and those a respawned civilization inherits, tell of no age until the next turn starts. The fixed research costs share the tier lookup.
